pages.text: The Void tier ends in Extended Crafting. Once a resource farms itself, you compress it: a thousand of it crushed into a single Singularity, one per vanilla Froglight resource.

The Quantum Compressor does the squeezing. Feed it the smelted resource - not the Froglight - with an Ultimate Catalyst in the catalyst slot, and out comes that resource's Singularity. The catalyst is not consumed, so one per compressor is all you need.
Gather every Singularity and fold the whole set together in the Ultimate Crafting Table to make one Ultimate Singularity - proof you automated every last farm.
Ring the Ultimate Singularity with Froglights, drop a Sweetslime in each bottom corner, and craft the Sky Frogs Master Frog. It does nothing. It is everything.
